fullTextZH: 你好，今天我要说一个故事，
fullTextEN: Hello, today I want to tell a story,

fullTextZH: 对，可是他是一个孩子，对，
fullTextEN: Right, but he was a child, right,
Why was he considered very smart,

fullTextZH: 一天有一个人送给他的爸爸，
fullTextEN: One day someone gave his father,
This elephant was very, very big,
So his father was very happy.

fullTextZH: 这么大的大象有多重呢？
fullTextEN: How heavy is such a big elephant?

fullTextZH: 所以他的爸爸想知道这只大象的重量，
fullTextEN: So his dad wants to know the weight of this elephant,

fullTextZH: 所以他的爸爸问所有人，
他说我要知道这只大象的重量，
fullTextEN: He said I want to know the weight of this elephant,

fullTextZH: 你们有没有什么好办法，
fullTextEN: Do you have any good ideas,

fullTextZH: 所有的人一起努力地想，
我们可以做一个很大很大的秤，对，
fullTextEN: We can make a very big scale, right,

fullTextZH: 然后我们可以用这个秤，
fullTextEN: Then we can use this scale,

fullTextZH: 因为如果你要做一个很大的秤太难了，
fullTextEN: because if you want to make a very large scale, it's too difficult,

fullTextZH: 也需要很多很多时间，嗯～
fullTextEN: it also takes a lot of time, hmm~
so this method is not good,

fullTextZH: 他说：我们可以把大象杀了，对，
fullTextEN: He said: We can kill the elephant, right,

fullTextZH: 然后把大象切成一块一块的，
fullTextEN: then cut the elephant into pieces,

fullTextZH: 对，我们可以一块一块地称，
fullTextEN: Right, we can weigh it piece by piece,

fullTextZH: 我们就知道大象的重量了。
fullTextEN: and we will know the weight of the elephant.

fullTextZH: 因为他们喜欢这只大象，
他们不要把大象杀了，对，
fullTextEN: they don't want to kill the elephant, right,

fullTextZH: 所以他们也不喜欢第二个办法，
fullTextEN: so they also don't like the second method,

fullTextZH: 继续想还有什么办法呢？
fullTextEN: Keep thinking, is there any other way?
At this time, there was a child,
He came, his name is Cao Chong,

fullTextZH: 对，他说他有一个好办法。
fullTextEN: Yes, he said he has a good idea.

fullTextZH: 第一个他需要一个船，对，
fullTextEN: First, he needs a boat, yes,
He needs a lot of stones,
He said this method has three steps,
Let the elephant go onto the boat,

fullTextZH: 你要刻一下水到的地方，对，
fullTextEN: You need to mark where the water reaches, yes,

fullTextZH: 第二步你要让大象下来，
fullTextEN: Second step, you need to let the elephant come down,

fullTextZH: 然后你放很多很多的石头，
fullTextEN: Then you put a lot of stones,

fullTextZH: 你要放到水到了刻的地方，对，
fullTextEN: You need to put until the water reaches the marked place, yes,

fullTextZH: 第三步你要称一下所有的石头，
fullTextEN: Third step, you need to weigh all the stones,

fullTextZH: 然后全部加起来就是大象的重量，
fullTextEN: Then adding it all up is the weight of the elephant,

fullTextZH: 啊，大家觉得这个办法很好。
fullTextEN: Ah, everyone thinks this method is great.

fullTextZH: 因为你不需要做一个很大的秤、
fullTextEN: Because you don't need to make a big scale,
You don't need to kill the elephant,
You only need a boat, ah,

fullTextZH: 那个时候他们有很多很多船
fullTextEN: At that time they had many, many boats

fullTextZH: 所以这个办法是最好最好的办法。
fullTextEN: So this method is the best of the best.

fullTextZH: 所以大家都觉得这个孩子曹冲，嗯～
fullTextEN: So everyone thinks this child Cao Chong, um,

fullTextZH: 所以我们有一个故事叫“曹冲称象” ，
fullTextEN: So we have a story called 'Cao Chong Weighs the Elephant',

fullTextZH: 对，在中国这个故事非常非常有名，
fullTextEN: Yes, in China this story is very, very famous,

fullTextZH: 好希望你喜欢这个故事。
fullTextEN: I hope you like this story.
Well, see you next time, bye!
